title: Cyber CTF
shortDescription: Hands-on cybersecurity labs on your own machine, server or cloud. Start a lab in one click, get an attack box on its network and practice real attacks safely.
description:
Cyber CTF is the desktop launcher for hands-on cybersecurity labs. Pick a lab, press Start, and a deliberately vulnerable environment builds itself, with your own attack box already on the lab network. Practice web attacks, Active Directory, containers and cloud misconfigurations on real systems, then submit what you find.

Run labs where it suits you:
- On this computer, as containers (Docker Desktop) or as virtual machines (VirtualBox or VMware Workstation)
- On your own server: Proxmox VE or VMware ESXi, for bigger multi-machine labs
- In your own cloud account: AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud, stopped automatically so you only pay while you practice

Every lab comes with a live network map of its machines, services and published ports, and an attack box you open in one click, right inside the app. Labs launched from www.cyberctf.org open straight in the launcher, and your progress follows your Cyber CTF account.

Built for students, security professionals and anyone learning ethical hacking. Only attack the labs Cyber CTF builds for you.

Requirements: Docker Desktop for container labs; VirtualBox or VMware Workstation for VM labs on this computer. The launcher helps you install what's missing.
releaseNotes:
- Version 1.4: Cyber CTF now has the same version number on every platform, the Microsoft Store included
- Windows: no more console windows opening, and the title bar follows the app's theme
- The app is now available in 6 languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Japanese
- Native build for Windows on Arm
- Share a folder with your attack box: your tools in, your loot out
- Your attack box opens in a terminal inside the app
- Network map: each lab's machines, services and attack box, with published ports linked to the service that serves them
- Labs on Proxmox and ESXi servers: more reliable setup, labs on internal Proxmox networks, and the full lab shown on the map
- Removing a lab now always cleans up everything it started
- Many fixes and speed improvements
